# Stage181 — full-real exact N14 auxiliary optimal interval

Status: **AUTHOR_EXACT_FULL_REAL_VERIFIED; NOT_ADMITTED**. Proven for an external ternary IID model, not a P000 six-axis Cell theorem or a native Source Result.

## Frozen sources

GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 main@bc7501521833d98b20efe03282fa7480f5964dfc; Enterprise Math main@c51161a2a4e4300910e39e260ce0cd9832ad56a9; predecessor Stage180 author commit 6985a5ef3a0cbba648664afab54956915713f66d. Exact predecessor dual181.json, proof and reference tools are used; no native review or formal owner claim is inferred.

## Definition and theorem

Let N=14, P=(1/8,1/24,5/6), Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6), and let a policy choose a stopping time ≤14 and final P/Q decision based on the entire ordered history, including arbitrary randomization. Define eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP=E_P tau, tQ=E_Q tau, and V14(alpha)=min max(tP,tQ) subject to eP,eQ≤alpha.

For every real delta satisfying

0 ≤ delta ≤ 2064436478960831/1998992954071424434176,

the exact optimal value is

**V14(alpha180+delta)=V180-(874008809438419348/2064436478960831)delta**,

where

- alpha180=1571047311779133836077/4497734146660704976896;
- V180=25552058910086071560277/2248867073330352488448;
- alpha181=6284207827044845991787/17990936586642819907584;
- V181=51102151300350906677021/4497734146660704976896.

This supporting affine line is strictly below the true optimum for every alpha>alpha181 (it does not assert the value function terminates).

## Exact dual lower bound

For count state h=(n,a,b), with a=#symbol0 and b=#symbol1, the history likelihood ratio is ell(h)=Q(h)/P(h)=2^(a+b)/3^a. This is exact on every full ordered prefix with the same counts. For

K=441833535662847516/2064436478960831,
L=432175273775571832/2064436478960831,

the finite Bellman recursion is

B(h)=min{K ell(h), L, 1+sum_i P_i B(h+i)},

with continuation disallowed at n=14. The first two actions decide P and Q respectively. Exact root H=1125553520578610530737003874877705/7068181637936142179391844122624. Therefore every history-dependent policy satisfies tP+K eQ+L eP≥H, so V14(alpha)≥H-(K+L)alpha.

All 680 count states (sum over 0≤n≤14 of (n+1)(n+2)/2) are exact-rational checked. There are precisely two ties: S=(9,0,1) Q/continue and U=(3,1,2) Q/continue. The remaining 1,238 action gaps are strictly positive; minimum 812296169382427/99092950990119888.

## Entire primal real interval

Use effective Q-action probabilities s at S and u at U; continue otherwise at ties, and use the unique Bellman action at every other state. S and U are incomparable along any history: U has more 0 and 1 counts than S although it is shallower, hence U cannot precede S; S is too deep to precede U. Thus each realized history visits at most one tie state. The complete observable vector X=(eP,eQ,tP,tQ) satisfies the **exact affine** relation

X(s,u)=X(0,0)+s*dS+u*dU

with zero mixed difference. Four deterministic-corner observables appear in certificate181.json, independently checked by exact suffix dynamic programming and full ordered-history DFS using integer weights (3,1,20)/24 under P and (1,1,10)/12 under Q. Corner DFS nodes 252916/244078/252484/243646; first-hit S has 9 ordered histories with P mass 390625/4478976 and Q mass 390625/2239488; first-hit U has 2 histories with P mass 1/2304 and Q mass 1/864.

Solving eP=eQ exactly yields

**s(u)=1555296121070003/9458452800000000 - (39343578000221/12611270400000000)u.**

For 0≤u≤1 this yields s(0)=1555296121070003/9458452800000000 and s(1)=6103153750279349/37833811200000000, both strictly between 0 and 1. The balanced error alpha(u) increases strictly and affinely from alpha180 to alpha181; Stage180's terminal S-coin and full left endpoint observables are recovered at u=0. The endpoint P-time domination margins are exactly 248709295303994102597/749622357776784162816 and 186877295703571825295/562216768332588122112, both positive. Affinity gives tP≥tQ throughout, so max(tP,tQ)=tP. All used actions are Bellman minimizing, thus tP+K eQ+L eP=H and the dual bound is attained for **every real** alpha in the specified interval.

## Right endpoint sharpness

Equality in the dual bound with K,L>0 forces both errors exactly alpha and all reached actions to be Bellman minimizers. At the two ties the likelihood ratio, suffix conditional law, and reachable probability are count-state determined. A history-conditioned randomized policy is therefore equivalent for these four observables to one effective coin in [0,1] per tie. Error balance forces the displayed s(u), along which alpha strictly increases with u≤1. Thus no dual-equality policy can have alpha>alpha181. Finite-horizon randomized behavior strategies form a compact product of finite probability simplices, so the optimum is attained; consequently the same support line is **strictly** below V14(alpha) for alpha>alpha181.
